verdict.rationale: Warp documents real data-egress controls. Telemetry can be opted out of and watched live in the native Network Log. Secret Redaction is always applied to AI interactions, Business/Enterprise plans get Zero Data Retention, and the client source is auditable under AGPL. Users also report that AI features like Prompt Suggestions and Next Command can be turned off. The caveats are significant: Free-plan users must keep telemetry on to use AI, and users report that Active AI sent terminal errors and output to LLMs proactively without explicit consent. Users also report login requirements, with AI only activating after login and one user blocked even from a local prompt, so the 'no forced login' part of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: login-free use (including login-free AI), AI data-sharing off by default with explicit consent, AI usable on the Free plan without telemetry, and a documented first-party global 'disable all AI' switch.
